title: The agents caught a real outage
line: A visitor asks Odin to check the agents. Then one agent's server is stopped for real, and Odin finds it, says what is wrong, and confirms the fix.

original.note: The recording, rewrapped without re-encoding so its header carries its length: the same 378 frames, the picture unchanged.

changes: the port check works on macOS
the outage card names the agent instead of its address

staged: The outage was staged on purpose, on a throwaway copy of the space started only for this film. The failure itself was real: the agent's server process was stopped, by its own process id, and nothing answered until it was started again.

steps.said: Good news: all 4 agents answered: Atlas (scripted), Pulse (http), Vega (scripted), Juno (scripted).

steps.event: Pulse's server process is stopped by its own process id: a real outage, not a mock.

steps.said: I found a problem: 3 of 4 agents answered; Pulse did not answer (its http brain failed: connection refused (nothing listens there)).

steps.event: Pulse's server is started again with the space's own start command, for that agent only.

steps.said: Good news: 4 of 4 places can be reached on foot from the entrance.

screening.method: one frame every 5 s, decoded with ffmpeg as raw rgb24 and viewed by an AI agent (the worker), not by a human; every frame at 2 per second, and the three poster frames, also read by text recognition
